page.overview:
Who is Jun-Chi?

Jun-Chi is an Adventurers Orient Expedition big figure introduced in 2003. He is exclusive to the set 7413 Passage of Jun-Chi.

Jun-Chi uses the same build as Tygurah and the Yeti and consists of six black pieces and one bright red piece. Legs and arms are attached to a body assembled from two Technic Brick 1X2, Ø4.9 and one Plate 2X2. This is covered by a single large bright red piece (unique to Jun-Chi) that comprises Jun-Chi's torso and head, which is molded in the likeness of a Shisa. His torso features blue and gold printing, and his head has white eyes, white teeth, and some blue hair.

The Jun-Chi is a large monster based on the Chinese myth of the Shisa, a half-lion, half-dog deity. He guards the Passage of Jun-Chi, which is portrayed in the online and magazine comics as a secret entrance to the Dragon Fortress; his appearance is so dreaded that even Dragon Fortress Guards avoid the passage. He gives chase to the Adventurers when they pass through. Shortly afterward, Jun-Chi barges into the Dragon Fortress, scattering the guards and allowing the Adventurers and Lord Sam Sinister to escape amidst the chaos.

In the 7413 set comic, Jun-Chi appears when Johnny Thunder tries to grab a ruby from the Passage of Jun-Chi, causing the revolving wall to spin around. Johnny escapes Jun-Chi by blocking the wall with a torch.
